report.body:
San Antonio stay at the summit at 16-4, with Portland next at 13-6.

Dallas made the week’s biggest leap, climbing 7 places to ninth.

Victor Wembanyama is Player of the Week after averaging 39.7 points, 17 rebounds and 2 assists across 3 games.
report.headline: San Antonio hold the top spot
